Statements.SQL: WITH "foundry_write_source" ("foundry_source_key") AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT "foundry_audit"."id" AS "foundry_source_key" FROM "foundry_audit" WHERE ("foundry_audit"."area" = $1) AND ("foundry_audit"."created_at" < $2) ORDER BY "foundry_audit"."created_at" ASC, "foundry_audit"."sequence" ASC LIMIT $3) DELETE FROM "foundry_audit" USING "foundry_write_source" WHERE ("foundry_audit"."area" = $4) AND ("foundry_audit"."created_at" < $5) AND ("foundry_audit"."id" = "foundry_write_source"."foundry_source_key")
